2609.01048.title: Lagged Coupling: Internal Representations Become Readable Before They Become Causal
2609.01048.paper_summary: Across the full Pythia suite (160M-12B, eight checkpoints, four task families), a linear probe can read a target variable from the residual stream as early as step 1,000 at every scale -- yet steering along that same reading direction remains null-equivalent in 43 of 48 model-checkpoint cells. Internal readability systematically outruns causal efficacy, and the lag does not shrink with scale. We call this structure lagged coupling and decompose it into three dissociable tracks: (i) internal readability, saturated (AUROC >= 0.990) from the first checkpoint everywhere; (ii) behavioral readability, which develops gradually and progressively later at larger scales (12B reaches 0.909 only at the final checkpoint); (iii) causal efficacy, almost always null-equivalent, occasionally counterproductive early, with one isolated positive pulse (12B, step 8,000, z = +2.49) our grid cannot resolve. The ordering is dominantly read-before-write (11/11 units, no inversion). Representation headroom along the probe direction grows up to 57x with training and scale while causal write-in stays below 0.11% of headroom -- the variable is increasingly written into the representation and increasingly ignored by the readout. Under a fully pre-registered protocol, both single-onset hypotheses resolve INDETERMINATE (scale slope +0.24, 95% CI [-0.60, +0.87]; time vote 3:3) -- a disciplined negative explained by the three-track decomposition. A pre-registered OLMo-2 replication preserves the direction at attenuated magnitude. Our results caution against inferring steerability from probe accuracy and establish a developmental bottleneck: representation formation reliably outpaces causal readout consolidation.
2609.01048.paper_summary_zh: 在整個 Pythia 套件中（160M-12B，八個檢查點，四個任務類別），線性探針可以在每個規模的第 1,000 步從殘差流中讀取目標變數——然而，在相同的讀取方向上進行引導在 48 個模型檢查點單元中有 43 個仍然是無效的。內部可讀性系統性地超越了因果效能，並且這一滯後隨著規模的增長並未縮小。我們稱這種結構為滯後耦合，並將其分解為三個可分離的軌道：（i）內部可讀性，從第一個檢查點開始在所有地方都達到飽和（AUROC >= 0.990）；（ii）行為可讀性，隨著規模的增大而逐漸發展，並且進展得更晚（12B 只有在最後一個檢查點達到 0.909）；（iii）因果效能，幾乎總是無效的，早期偶爾會產生反效果，並且有一個孤立的正脈衝（12B，第 8,000 步，z = +2.49）我們的網格無法解析。排序主要是讀取在寫入之前（11/11 單元，無反轉）。沿著探針方向的表示空間隨著訓練和規模的增長而增長至 57 倍，而因果寫入保持在表示空間的 0.11% 以下——這個變數越來越多地被寫入表示中，並且越來越被讀出所忽視。在完全預註冊的協議下，兩個單次發作的假設都解決為不確定（規模斜率 +0.24，95% CI [-0.60, +0.87]；時間投票 3:3）——這是一個有紀律的負面，通過三軌分解來解釋。預註冊的 OLMo-2 複製保持了方向但幅度減弱。我們的結果警告不要從探針的準確性推斷可引導性，並建立了一個發展瓶頸：表示形成可靠地超越了因果讀出整合。
2609.01048.author: Xining Xun et.al.
